title: bst-natural/1 parameter file
description: One member of bst-natural/1, the natural scenario with a point mass (constraint-scenarios.md), as model.md names its free parameters. The natural constraint a > -h_min is the constraint in force, so the file states no artificial one. Draft.
$comment: This validator checks names, types and ranges. The checker checks the rest: the shared rules (shares, the order of the types, income 0 with probability 0, wp * xi_u < 1, each law's own rules) and the scenario's: both laws bounded, with strictly positive lower and finite upper bounds; the joint worst income, the worst transitory income with psi at its floor, a point mass; and G psi_min < R, so that h_min is finite.
